item.title: Apache Syncope User Self-Service Privilege Escalation (CVE-2026-62183)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — web · CVE-2026-62183 / CWE-269 (Improper Privilege Management; mechanism CWE-862 Missing Authorization) / Apache Syncope security advisory, fixed by SYNCOPE-1983. Status: PoC — runtime-confirmed minimal proof using documented REST API calls; the upstream author explicitly does not present it as a weaponized exploit. Affects: Apache Syncope identity and access management server (Core REST API, user self-service workflow). Tags: apache, syncope, identity-management, privilege-escalation, cwe-269, cwe-862, rest-api, self-service, authorization-bypass, java.

item.title: FreeIPA Anonymous OTP ACI Abuse — Unauthenticated Kerberos Principal Injection and Admin Takeover (CVE-2026-76578)
item.description: Critical severity (CVSS 9.8) — network · CVE-2026-76578 (companion flaw: CVE-2026-76560 in 389-ds-base). Status: Weaponized. Affects: FreeIPA (ipa-server) self-managed OTP token ACI under cn=otp, evaluated by the 389-ds-base directory server. Tags: FreeIPA, LDAP, Kerberos, authentication-bypass, ACI, unauthenticated, privilege-escalation, 389-ds, identity-management, CWE-306.
